data.animaCaption: Pressed back against the bookshelves in the narrow library aisle, she grips the lifted hem of her plaid skirt with tearful, crimson-flushed embarrassment and parted lips. Low golden-hour sunlight pours down the passage and ignites a bright rim along her hair.
data.promptProse: Framed at a tense tilted angle down a cramped wooden library aisle, Ayachi Nene leans breathlessly back against a towering bookshelf in her Himematsu navy blazer and black thighhighs. Caught mid-episode by the viewer, her trembling fingers hold the edge of her grey plaid pleated miniskirt lifted to reveal pale pink bow-trimmed panties while beads of sweat glisten on her heavily flushed cheeks and tears gather in her wide purple eyes. Late golden-hour sunlight floods down the narrow corridor from behind the stacks, casting vivid warm rim light along her silver hair and blazer.
data.story: 黄昏的图书室只剩书页和呼吸声。因魔石代价发作而躲在窄书架间的宁宁无处可逃，被夕阳照透的眼角沁出泪光，抓着格裙边缘的手指都在轻颤——「不、不要看……请把眼睛闭上，求你了……」
